candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: u/U is dimensionless because both u and U are velocities. Dimensional analysis (Buckingham Pi) with inputs U (L T^-1), nu (L^2 T^-1), x (L) and y (L) yields two dimensionless groups. The relevant similarity variable is eta = y * sqrt(U/(nu x)), and the dimensionless streamwise velocity takes the similarity form u/U = f(eta) (Blasius solution).
